Eagles vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, November 1 · NFL Week 8 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 31, 10:48 AM ET

Jayden Daniels has the highest SPAGS projection in the Eagles at Commanders DraftKings Showdown: 19.9 points at $10,400 FLEX, 29.9 at captain for $15,600. In a game totaled at 40.5, the model's favorite play is the quarterback who also runs. It has him carrying 6.6 times, and across 10,000 simulations he holds 84% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Daniels is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 7.3 points at a $10,400 FLEX salary.

He also has the largest captain share: 33.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Daniels at captain. Saquon Barkley is the next captain in line, at 14.9%. The model gives him 17.0 carries and 2.1 targets.

Washington is a 6-point favorite, and the implied totals are 23.25 for the Commanders and 17.25 for the Eagles. Neither number describes a shootout. Both describe a game where somebody has to carry the ball.

Behind Daniels and Barkley, the next projections are Tanner McKee (12.2, $8,800), Rachaad White (12.2, $8,000) and Dallas Goedert (11.6, $7,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 31, 10:48 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jayden Daniels, WAS QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Jayden Daniels holds 33.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 19.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 29.9 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 6.6 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Daniels averaged 19.9 points with a simulated floor of 7.3 and a ceiling of 40.1. He holds 84% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 33.5% as the captain and 50.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Saquon Barkley, PHI RB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Saquon Barkley holds 14.9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 14.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 21.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 17.0 carries and 2.1 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Barkley averaged 14.1 points with a simulated floor of 3.5 and a ceiling of 32.4. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.9% as the captain and 38.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Rachaad White, WAS RB ($8,000 FLEX / $12,000 CPT)

Rachaad White holds 10.8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $12,000 and the 12.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 18.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 11.8 carries and 2.6 targets. Across 10,000 simulations White averaged 12.1 points with a simulated floor of 3.2 and a ceiling of 27.1. He holds 47% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.8% as the captain and 36.7% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Eagles vs Commanders

Tanner McKee, PHI QB ($8,800 FLEX / $13,200 CPT)

Across 10,000 simulations McKee averaged 12.3 points with a simulated floor of 4.1 and a ceiling of 25.0. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.9% as the captain and 47.0% in a FLEX spot.

Dallas Goedert, PHI TE ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

Dallas Goedert carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.6 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 6.8 targets on 20.9 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Goedert averaged 11.6 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 27.1. He holds 44% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.9% as the captain and 35.5% in a FLEX spot.

Stefon Diggs carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.8 DraftKings points for a $9,000 FLEX salary ($13,500 at captain). The model gives him 6.2 targets on 21.9 routes. He holds 38% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.5% as the captain and 32.3% in a FLEX spot.

Makai Lemon, PHI WR ($7,000 FLEX / $10,500 CPT)

Makai Lemon carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.3 DraftKings points for a $7,000 FLEX salary ($10,500 at captain). The model gives him 7.3 targets on 32.8 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Lemon averaged 10.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.4 and a ceiling of 22.4. He holds 40% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.1% as the captain and 34.5% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Drew Stevens, WAS K ($4,600 FLEX / $6,900 CPT)

Drew Stevens projects for 8.3 DraftKings points at a $4,600 FLEX salary, 1.81 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Stevens averaged 8.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 16.0. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.8% as the captain and 30.2% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Commanders, WAS DST ($4,000 FLEX / $6,000 CPT)

Commanders projects for 6.7 DraftKings points at a $4,000 FLEX salary, 1.68 projected points per $1,000. Across 10,000 simulations Commanders averaged 6.7 points with a simulated floor of -0.6 and a ceiling of 16.1. It holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.3% as the captain and 25.3% in a FLEX spot.

Eagles vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Eagles vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

Jayden Daniels holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 33.5%, ahead of Saquon Barkley (14.9%) and Rachaad White (10.8%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Eagles vs Commanders?

Build around Jayden Daniels at captain with Saquon Barkley, Stefon Diggs and Makai Lemon at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (12 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $8,600 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Eagles vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

Jayden Daniels leads the SPAGS model at 19.9 DraftKings points for $10,400 at FLEX, or 29.9 points at captain for $15,600.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Eagles vs Commanders Showdown?

Jayden Daniels is the most expensive player at $10,400 FLEX and $15,600 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Eagles vs Commanders DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Drew Stevens (8.3 points at $4,600), Commanders (6.7 points at $4,000) and Jake Elliott (7.3 points at $5,000).

What is the Eagles vs Commanders spread and total?

The Commanders are a 6-point favorite in a game totaled at 40.5, with implied team totals of 23.25 for the Commanders and 17.25 for the Eagles.
